title: Skeleton in Velvet Suit
description: A skeletal figure in a red velvet suit and glowing blue helmet stands in a dilapidated mansion interior, holding a cane. Behind him is a large circular portal with green thorny vines showing a destroyed cityscape with cars and flying creatures, while orange flames and smoke emanate from the scene.
prompt: A skeletal figure wearing an ornate red velvet suit with gold details and a glowing blue visor helmet stands confidently in a decaying grand mansion with broken stairs and chandeliers. He holds a decorative cane in gloved hands. A large circular portal framed by glowing green thorny vines reveals a destroyed city street with abandoned cars and flying creatures under a green sky. Orange flames and smoke swirl around the portal edge, dramatic lighting, dark fantasy atmosphere.
